product.title: Oahu: Grand Tour Around Island with Snorkeling

description.text: This Oahu day includes snorkeling plus Diamond Head State Monument, the Halona Blowhole, and the Dole Plantation. Other named stops are Makapu'u Beach, Kahuku Farms, and Waimea Bay. Snacks and snorkeling gear are provided, and pickup at the hotel is part of the day. Those named stops and the snorkeling share the same day, with the snacks and gear provided. Diamond Head State Monument, the Halona Blowhole, the Dole Plantation, Makapu'u Beach, Kahuku Farms, and Waimea Bay are the places named alongside the snorkeling on this Oahu day.
